summary.name: mpv
summary.one_liner: mpv is a free, open source, cross-platform media player for the command line with minimal GUI, scripting, and high-quality video output.
use_cases: play video and audio files from the terminal
watch HDR or high-quality video with advanced scaling
embed a media player in another application via C API
summary.what_it_does: mpv is a media player run from the command line that supports a wide range of media file formats, audio and video codecs, and subtitle types. It offers scripting so users can extend its behavior with user scripts from the wiki. Its video output is based on OpenGL, Vulkan, and D3D11 and includes video scaling, color management, frame timing, interpolation, and HDR. It can use most hardware decoding APIs on all platforms, enabled at runtime. It also provides a C API so it can be used as a library inside other applications.
notable: Provides a C API for embedding as a library
Scripting support with a large selection of user scripts
OpenGL, Vulkan, and D3D11 video output with HDR and interpolation
Minimal interface with only a small on-screen controller
caveats: Provides no real GUI beyond a small on-screen controller, so it is oriented to command-line use
